steps.u: Weekly active users in the dashboard dropped 15% last week. Is that real or a tracking problem?

i.command: bq query 'select date, count(distinct user_id) from events group by 1 order by 1 desc limit 14'
bq query 'select app_version, count(*) from events where date>="2026-11-12" group by 1'

steps.a: The drop starts exactly when version 4.19 shipped. Events from 4.19 are far fewer per user, suggesting the event is not fired. Active users are counted by a login event; I will check if 4.19 sends it.

i.command: bq query 'select event_name, count(*) from events where app_version="4.19" group by 1'

steps.a: Version 4.19 sends no login event, so those users are not counted as active; the drop is a tracking regression, not a real fall in usage. Counting distinct users on any event instead of login shows 47k for last week.

i.content: Cause: login event missing in 4.19. Adjusted WAU on any event: 47k. Fix: restore login event; backfill is not possible.

reference.summary: Investigated a 15 percent drop in weekly active users with BigQuery and showed it was a tracking regression: app version 4.19 stopped sending the login event used to count activity, and counting on any event gives about 47k.
facts: tracking regression not real usage drop

decisions.choice: compare event counts by app version
decisions.reason: the drop started on the day the new version shipped
